sources.title: Tinker managed training overview
sources.method: Managed training API using LoRA; current supported models are a changing provider catalog.
sources.reuseConstraint: Remote credentials, data-transfer review and a separate budget are pending; not a local training engine.

sources.title: Tinker Cookbook
sources.method: Client-side SFT, RL, DPO and distillation examples run on Tinker.
sources.reuseConstraint: Apache-2.0 code license verified separately; model, dataset and hosted-service terms remain separate.

sources.title: Cookbook LICENSE
sources.reuseConstraint: No permission inferred for example datasets, model weights or blog text.

sources.title: LoRA Without Regret
sources.method: Ranks, learning rates, target modules and batch sizes influence results; conclusions are experiment-specific.
sources.reuseConstraint: No guarantee of transfer to quantized local Qwen3-0.6B/MLX.

sources.title: On-Policy Distillation
sources.method: Student-generated trajectories are graded with teacher token probabilities; support and teacher quality matter.
sources.reuseConstraint: Teacher API/model-output reuse must be approved; no teacher calls made.

sources.title: Defeating Nondeterminism in LLM Inference
sources.method: Changing batch sizes and numerical reductions can change inference even apart from sampling.
sources.reuseConstraint: CUDA/kernel examples do not prove MLX equivalence.

sources.title: Learning to Replicate Expert Judgment in Financial Tasks
sources.method: Expert correction of contested training labels is separated from held-out evaluation.
sources.reuseConstraint: Publisher results use a proprietary task/dataset and larger base model; no MEW performance inference.

sources.title: Learning from Preferences
sources.method: DPO directly learns chosen versus rejected responses; RLHF additionally trains a reward model.
sources.reuseConstraint: Model-generated preferences are not human approvals; local DPO support not established.

sources.title: LoRA: Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models
sources.method: Low-rank trainable updates adapt frozen model weights.
sources.reuseConstraint: Paper methods are reference only, no paper text exported for training.

sources.title: Direct Preference Optimization
sources.method: Preference optimization can avoid fitting a separate reward model.
sources.reuseConstraint: Pairwise labels and implementation compatibility must be verified.

sources.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks
sources.method: Combines retrieval memory with generation for knowledge tasks.
sources.reuseConstraint: Retrieved content still needs provenance and applicable reuse decisions.

sources.title: Who Validates the Validators?
sources.method: Aligning automated evaluation with human preferences requires attention to evaluator validity.
sources.reuseConstraint: No claim of complete PDF reading or validated MEW judge.

limitations: Official YouTube channel link resolved to an inaccessible page; no video/transcript used.
Guessed standalone pricing path unavailable; no price assumption recorded.
Paper abstracts were read; complete PDFs were not examined.
